correctness.rationale: Trace of 2x2 idempotent equals rank, and trace-zero/determinant-zero characterize nilpotents. Rank-one projections indexed by complementary lines give q+1-e(A)+q e_{1-d}(A) for trace-one A. Evaluating its characteristic polynomial at 1-d gives d^2, so correction only at d=0. Standard GL2 centralizer sizes yield every displayed split/irreducible/Jordan stratum; q=2 coincident bins are added. Independently enumerated every idempotent and decomposition over F2,F3,F5 and all matrices, reproducing exact histograms and maximum. Infinite all-prime-power statement comes from projective-line proof and class enumeration.
